reviewRole: Independent fig-301 visual/source-fidelity reviewer in fresh image context
scope: Frozen final repair-1 only. Independently compare the absolute canonical figure PNG against actual 316px and 640px candidate images. Consume current repaired bilingual text and affected SCI/ZHEN approval; do not reopen source pages or replay science review. No promotion, app operation or whole-card acceptance.

independentSourcePixelInventory.provenance: Original canonical PNG opened first, before reading the candidate spec or author source inventory. Source observations were then reconciled against spec, actual candidate pixels, and XML; author observations were not substituted for independent image inspection.
independentSourcePixelInventory.axes: One perpendicular horizontal/vertical frame; rightward and upward positive arrows. The horizontal axis extends left of the common origin and the vertical axis extends below it. There are no negative-end arrows. Both candidate sizes preserve this layout.
independentSourcePixelInventory.curve: One solid curve starts exactly at the axes' intersection, rises steeply into the positive-positive quadrant and progressively flattens near its right endpoint. It ends well before the positive horizontal arrow, without an extension, direction arrow, labelled saturation point or return path. Both actual candidate sizes preserve these relationships.
independentSourcePixelInventory.symbols: Source vertical symbol is I, not electric-current relabelling or modern M; the horizontal symbol is B with subscript zero, with no vector accent. The source origin has an italic zero-shaped glyph below-left of the intersection, preserved as 0. The modern font changes typography, not the symbol identities or sides of the axes.
independentSourcePixelInventory.tickAdjudication: The original horizontal stroke has small irregular projections and thickness changes, including an isolated upward bump. They do not form a repeated scale, have no paired values and are consistent with the irregular scanned strokes elsewhere. No instructional tick sequence is visible; retaining clean unticked axes neither removes a readable graduation nor invents scale values.
requirementsMapped: 301-source-shared-axes: all four mapped axis/arrow objects and seven mapped assertions resolve.

301-source-single-initial-curve: the one mapped svgPath and its mapped count, common-origin and endpoint-offset assertions resolve; the reviewer additionally checks actual path endpoints, continuity, positive quadrant and slope.
301-source-symbols-and-no-scale: all three text objects and the text-count assertion resolve; actual SVG text is exactly I, B-subscript-zero and 0.
independentSourcePixelInventory.modernAdditions: A clean neutral vector presentation, larger typesetting and two smooth cubic pieces forming one continuous path. Canvas coordinates and control points are explicitly unmeasured regularization, not source experimental coordinates, calibrated ticks or given magnetic values.
independentSourcePixelInventory.sourceFidelityDecision: PASS from independent original/candidate pixels, not from renderer pass or byte determinism.

imageOpenLog.purpose: Actual mobile candidate source fidelity, glyphs and clearance
Full-resolution desktop candidate source fidelity, continuous solid curve and glyphs

scientificAndCulturalFidelity.judgment: The figure agrees with current edition text: I is the material's magnetic flux-density contribution B-B_0; the displayed trace is the initial increasing-field process from an approximately demagnetized state, not current, a hysteresis loop or a saturation plateau of the total internal B. The graph stays qualitative and supplies no invented measurements, material constants, remanence or coercive intercepts. Broader SCI/ZHEN approval is consumed, not repeated.
scientificAndCulturalFidelity.curveEndpoint: Actual frozen SVG starts at screen (90,442), the shared user origin (90,78), and ends at screen (450,150), user (450,370). It remains within the positive quadrant. Independent derivative inspection yields positive decreasing slope, from about 2.5818 to 0.03226; these dimensionless canvas slopes are not physical data.

symbolGlyphAndDisplayChecks.otherDeclaredWidthChecks: No additional widths are declared. Author hash-bound native checks are consumed; no geometry rerender is performed.
symbolGlyphAndDisplayChecks.glyphFontEvidence: Actual SVG uses font-size 34 on each text node with no nested tspan, subscript font reduction or transform. Frozen platform-font evidence has one Arial glyph for I, one Arial glyph for B plus one Helvetica glyph for Unicode subscript zero, and one Arial glyph for origin 0. All glyphs are present in the independently opened candidate images.
symbolGlyphAndDisplayChecks.minimumTextInterpretation: The skill's 16px requirement is final transformed font size, not a claim that every glyph's ink height is 16px. Unicode subscript zero retains its intrinsic subscript shape within the same 34px text font.
symbolGlyphAndDisplayChecks.clearanceMethod: Positive label/axis/arrow/canvas clearances derived read-only from the hash-bound author native DOM rectangles and frozen SVG geometry; independently checked visually at both actual widths.

authorNativeWidthChecksConsumed.scope: Isolated native SVG fixture, not full card or app approval.

repairBudget.onFailure: Stop and mark fail; no further repair approval.

nextGate: Parent-owned full-card display/offline acceptance and any separately authorized durable promotion. Current independent fig-301 approval does not supply whole-card approval.
